generate_podspec: generate an abseil CocoaPods podspec file from Bazel BUILD.bazel files with a given version
collect_rules: collect all cc_library rules recursively from BUILD.bazel files in the abseil directory tree
parse_rule: parse a Bazel XML rule element into a Rule namedtuple with normalized paths and dependencies
normalize_paths: normalize Bazel label paths by stripping leading slashes and replacing colons with forward slashes
write_podspec: write a complete CocoaPods podspec file with subspecs and dependencies from collected Bazel rules
